gallery.description:
Telephoto picture taken overlooking the Selby Campground from the road above in the Caliente Range, eastern San Luis Obispo County, California.  
This photo shows details of the campsite canopies and the Selby Rocks formation in Carrizo Plain National Monument.
"See other photo for wider view."

gallery.title: File:Carizzo plain spring flowers in bloom 5.jpg
gallery.description:
Spring on the Carrizo Plain National Monument — in eastern San Luis Obispo County, central California.
The field of bright yellow flowers in the foreground are hill-side daisies (Monolopia lanceolata). The blue flowers in the distance are blue phacelia.
categories: Asteroideae in the Northern Hemisphere in March
